dedupe_keys.name: water footprints and crop water use of 175 crops 1990 2019 simulated with the acea global crop model 4tu researchdata

description: Global gridded outputs of green and blue water footprints and crop water use for 175 crops from 1990 to 2019, simulated at 5 arc-minutes (about 10 km) with ACEA, a process-based gridded crop model based on FAO AquaCrop. The 4TU.ResearchData record says water footprints are split into green (precipitation) and blue (irrigation or capillary rise) water, for rainfed and irrigated systems, with unit water footprints in cubic metres per tonne, water footprints of production in cubic metres per year and crop water use in millimetres per year, plus harvested area and production. Version 3 was issued on 19 May 2025 (first upload August 2023, a data descriptor in Scientific Data) and holds 12 downloadable files of about 39.7 GB in total: NetCDF4 grids and CSV summary sheets for national and global values, with a readme, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is global cropland over 30 years. Caveats: values are modelled, and methods, validation and uncertainty are described in the data paper, not the record. For simulation it gives irrigation water demand by crop, grid cell and year, to load water supply and irrigation network models and to test drought impacts on food production. Related catalogue records include the GCWM monthly crop water use and MIRCA2000 crop areas.
